contextmenu-selection-report-order.strategy: fc.record({current: fc.record({kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation'), id: fc.string()}), hit: fc.record({kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation'), id: fc.string()})}).filter((value) => value.current.kind !== value.hit.kind || value.current.id !== value.hit.id)

ordinary-pointerdown.strategy: fc.record({button: fc.integer({ min: -1, max: 5 }).filter((button) => button !== 2), tool: fc.constantFrom('select', 'hand', 'annotation'), detail: fc.nat({ max: 3 }), clientX: fc.integer(), clientY: fc.integer(), shiftKey: fc.boolean(), metaKey: fc.boolean(), hit: fc.constantFrom('empty', 'node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation')})

helpers.findCommand: const findCommand = (id: string): unknown => COMMANDS.find((command) => command.id === id);

additive-hit.strategy: fc.record({ current: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') })), hit: fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') }) })

anchor-grip-press.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 0, tool: 'select', additive: false, onAnchorGrip: value }, []);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'anchor', ref: value });

create-annotation.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 10, y: 20 }, button: 0, tool: 'annotation', additive: false, hit: { id: 'under', kind: 'node' }, onAnchorGrip: { id: 'anchor', kind: 'annotation' }, onHandle: {} as never }, [{ id: 'under', kind: 'node' }]);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'create-annotation', selection: [] });

marquee-empty-space.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 0, tool: 'select', additive: false }, []);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'marquee', selection: [] });

move-selected-hit.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') }), { minLength: 1 }).map((current) => ({ current, hit: current[current.length - 1] }))

move-unselected-hit.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 0, tool: 'select', additive: false, hit: value.hit }, value.current);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'move', selection: [value.hit] });
move-unselected-hit.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') })).map((current) => current.map((ref, index) => ({ ...ref, id: `selected-${index}-${ref.id}` }))).map((current) => ({ current, hit: { id: 'outside', kind: 'node' } }))

pan-press.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: value.button, tool: value.tool, additive: true, hit: { id: 'hit', kind: 'node' }, onAnchorGrip: { id: 'anchor', kind: 'annotation' }, onHandle: {} as never }, [{ id: 'selected', kind: 'node' }]);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'pan' });
pan-press.strategy: fc.record({ button: fc.integer().filter((button) => button !== 2), tool: fc.constantFrom('select', 'hand', 'annotation') })

right-click-empty-space.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 2, tool: 'select', additive: false }, []);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'none', selection: [] });

right-click-selected-hit.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') }), { minLength: 1 }).map((current) => ({ current, hit: current[0] }))

right-click-unselected-hit.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 2, tool: 'select', additive: false, hit: value.hit }, value.current);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'none', selection: [value.hit] });
right-click-unselected-hit.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), kind: fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') })).map((current) => current.map((ref, index) => ({ ...ref, id: `selected-${index}-${ref.id}` }))).map((current) => ({ current, hit: { id: 'outside', kind: 'node' } }))

stale-handle-with-empty-selection.body:
const decision = routePress({ point: { x: 0, y: 0 }, button: 0, tool: 'select', additive: false, onHandle: value as never }, []);
expect(decision).toEqual({ kind: 'marquee', selection: [] });

menu-items-use-current-selection.strategy: fc.array(fc.constantFrom({ kind: 'node', id: 'node-1' }, { kind: 'edge', id: 'edge-1' }, { kind: 'group', id: 'group-1' }, { kind: 'annotation', id: 'annotation-1' }), { maxLength: 4 })

selection-changes-while-open.strategy: fc.record({ before: fc.array(fc.constantFrom({ kind: 'node', id: 'node-1' }, { kind: 'edge', id: 'edge-1' }, { kind: 'group', id: 'group-1' }, { kind: 'annotation', id: 'annotation-1' }), { maxLength: 4 }), after: fc.array(fc.constantFrom({ kind: 'node', id: 'node-1' }, { kind: 'edge', id: 'edge-1' }, { kind: 'group', id: 'group-1' }, { kind: 'annotation', id: 'annotation-1' }), { maxLength: 4 }) })

negative-clamped-position.strategy: fc.record({ width: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 10000 }), height: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 10000 }) })

non-empty-items.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ id: fc.string(), label: fc.string(), chord: fc.string() }), { minLength: 1 })

position-within-window.strategy: fc.record({ x: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 100 }), y: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 100 }) })

keymap-data-formats-command-chords.strategy: fc.array(fc.constantFrom('ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Escape', 'x', 'q') as const, { minLength: 1 }).map((keys: readonly ('ArrowUp' | 'ArrowDown' | 'ArrowLeft' | 'ArrowRight' | 'Escape' | 'x' | 'q')[]) => [keys[0]] as const)

no-applicable-commands-returns-empty.body:
const commands = value.map((id: string) => makeCommand(id));
expect(contextMenuItems([], commands, [])).toEqual([]);

nonmatching-kind-list-is-excluded.strategy: fc.tuple(fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') as const, fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') as const).filter((pair: readonly ['node' | 'edge' | 'group' | 'annotation', 'node' | 'edge' | 'group' | 'annotation']) => pair[0] !== pair[1])

selection-change-does-not-reorder-surviv.strategy: fc.record({ first: fc.array(fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') as const), second: fc.array(fc.constantFrom('node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') as const), commands: fc.array(fc.constantFrom('global', 'node', 'edge', 'group', 'annotation') as const, { minLength: 1 }) })

helpers.makeCommand: const makeCommand = (id: string, appliesTo?: 'global' | Array<'node' | 'edge' | 'group' | 'annotation'>): Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[1][number] => ({ id: id as Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[1][number]['id'], label: id, run: () => {}, ...(appliesTo === undefined ? {} : { appliesTo }) } as Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[1][number]);
helpers.makeElement: const makeElement = (kind: 'node' | 'edge' | 'group' | 'annotation', id: string): Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[0][number] => ({ id, kind } as Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[0][number]);
helpers.makeKeymap: const makeKeymap = (command: string, key: 'ArrowUp' | 'ArrowDown' | 'ArrowLeft' | 'ArrowRight' | 'Escape' | 'x' | 'q'): Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[2][number] => ({ command: command as Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[2][number]['command'], chord: { key } } as Parameters<typeof contextMenuItems>[2][number]);

eligible-command.strategy: fc.record({ label: fc.string(), appliesTo: fc.constantFrom('global', ['node']) , hasBinding: fc.boolean() })

matching-keymap-entry.strategy: fc.array(fc.record({ key: fc.constant('x'), meta: fc.constant(false), shift: fc.constant(false) }), { minLength: 1 })
